prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
For a family of four, I’d start with **The Duo**, a two-bedroom, one-bathroom downtown Airbnb with two king beds and about 900 sq. ft. It’s specifically described as family-friendly and gives parents and kids separate sleeping rooms. The listing guide reports a rate around **$400/night**, but that may be outdated and doesn’t necessarily include fees. [See the listing guide](https://www.bode.co/blog/best-nashville-airbnbs)

If you’d rather have more room or outdoor amenities, Airbnb’s family-friendly Nashville page currently features **“Cozy Courtyard, 4BD/2.5BA, 4 miles to DT—Hot Tub!”**, rated **4.92/5 from 259 reviews**. It’s a better fit if you’re comfortable staying outside downtown and driving or using rideshares. [Browse family-friendly Airbnb stays](https://www.airbnb.com/nashville-tn/stays/family-friendly)

**My quick recommendation:** choose The Duo for walkable downtown access; choose the four-bedroom courtyard home for extra space. Check the total price, parking, cancellation terms, and recent reviews for your dates before booking—availability and rates vary. If you share your dates, budget, and whether you’ll have a car, I can narrow down what to look for.
